final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT trans.account_id, district.A3, AVG(trans.amount) as avg_amount FROM trans JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id GROUP BY trans.account_id, district.A3), step2 AS (SELECT A3, AVG(avg_amount) as avg_of_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY A3), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_of_avg) as overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.A3, step2.avg_of_avg, step2.avg_of_avg - step3.overall_avg as difference FROM step2, step3 WHERE step2.avg_of_avg > step3.overall_avg), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_of_avg) as overall_avg FROM step2) SELECT step4.A3, step4.avg_of_avg, step4.difference, step4.avg_of_avg / step5.overall_avg as ratio FROM step4, step5 WHERE step5.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY step4.A3
